confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are steadier than accommodation, which varies by district and season. Cocktail and wine were set relative to beer (about 3.25x and 2.75x) because direct price knowledge is weaker. The FX value came from search-result summaries attributed to RBA pages, and the 14 Oct 2026 figure could not be corroborated elsewhere; verify it against the RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors follow general Southeast Asian capital-city price tiers, with Manila adjustments: peso-priced local food and beer run lower, imported wine is pricier because of import duties, and hotel prices span budget stock in Malate/Ermita to three-star stock in Makati/BGC.
